on the ticket, calling rules by market, recording notices by place, QA lessons and a practice organisation in the Academy.

Apps on the ticket: agents can use small apps beside a ticket. The first apps are Translate, Customer's calls, Jira, Slack, Teams and Shopify. An app can have its own server, and public apps are reviewed by the platform operator before anyone can install them. Organisations cannot delete or take over a public app. Settings that hold secrets are kept out of requests and never shown back. A developers' guide is included.

Operator setup for ticket apps: set `APPS_SANDBOX_HOSTNAME` and `APPS_SANDBOX_ORIGIN` and add DNS for the sandbox address. Until this is done, apps will not open.

Calling-rule templates: each market has a ready-made set of calling rules, and Australian state is read from the area code. They are starting points, not legal advice. Check them with your own advisers.

Recording notices by place: set which notice plays for which place. The list starts empty, so nothing changes until you add entries. The places supplied are starting points, not legal advice. If a notice cannot play, the call is marked not recorded.

Do-not-call registers: resellers can fetch their register copy from an address, zipped or not. A campaign can hold calls on a register that only warns. This is off by default.

QA auto-lesson: a low score or a failed must-pass item can give the agent an Academy lesson, with a Lessons and scores page and a lesson-impact report. Off by default.

Academy practice organisation: each learner gets a practice organisation with five admin tasks that are checked automatically, and a reset. It is kept out of real lists, billing and sweeps, and sends no real mail or messages.

What's new lessons: each release's notes become an Academy lesson for agents and for administrators. Other languages fall back to English.

Get the apps: reseller-branded download links page, with link lists per reseller and a platform default.

Call Control: a settings page, saving gated by plan, help guide and Academy questions.

Reports: the call record download shows each call's carrier, with a Carrier filter on Hangup causes. Calls with none show Unknown.

Organisation move: move one organisation between region installations.

Sub-processors: Anthropic is listed as a platform sub-processor.

SIP edge: servers behind NAT in the cloud advertise their public address. Servers without NAT are unchanged.

Held back: narrated Academy lessons are not in this release.

Migrations: 7066, 7067, 7070, 7080, 7090, 7091, 7092, 7100, 7120, 7130, 7140, 7150, 7200.

Fixes: a bad date or team filter on the QA lesson report is a 400, not a server error; real organisations come first in a person's Academy list; a double practice reset leaves nothing behind; an organisation move can no longer be undone once a newer move exists; the failing integration tests on staging are fixed at their cause."}
